title: Figure 36: Evaluation of Object Sightings in Strategic Areas of the South Midwest Region
description: Regional map of the southern United States from Texas to Georgia showing outlined strategic areas around Waco, San Antonio and Atlanta, each labeled with an object-sighting count and linked to a pie chart of evaluation categories (Astro, Aircraft, Balloon, Insuf. info., Other, Unknown). A further pie gives the "Balance of South Midwest Region" (210 object sightings). Caption: "FIGURE 36 COMPARISON OF EVALUATION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS IN THE STRATEGIC AREAS OF THE SOUTH MIDWEST REGION"; drawing B-7514.
